claim: muxr 0.2.20 pairs, attaches through pane churn, sends text from the box, scrolls history back and forward, opens Usage and comes back, with exactly one host alive

steps.start: the release app freshly installed on the phone, with a lab computer running two agent panes that the phone is not yet paired to
steps: pair the phone to the lab computer
open an agent and time its first attach, from the tap to the host's new terminal stream
close agent panes and attach again through pane churn
type a command at the agent
scroll its history back and forward fast
steps.result: the first attach took 1266 ms from the tap to the host's new terminal stream, the phone attached after every round of pane churn, the typed command printed its output on a clean screen, the history scrolled back and forward, Usage opened and closed, and one host stayed alive
